reply.text: That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't tell you whether it's normal or what it means. If it's sharp, spreading, or comes with numbness or tingling, get it looked at soon. Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll build your training around it. In the meantime, I'm happy to look at your deadlift history or your pulling program with you.
